## Setup checklist
1. Open **Call Apify 2GIS Actor** → Authentication is set to Predefined Credential Type → Apify API. Click the credential dropdown and select/create your Apify credential there (no token pasted in code anywhere).
2. Actor ID in **Build Apify Request** is `thenetaji~2gis-search-scraper` (apify.com/thenetaji/2gis-search-scraper) — searches by query+city. A real test run against the sibling `2gis-place-scraper` actor confirmed THAT one needs `placeIds` (a deep-enrichment-by-ID actor, not search), which is why it was swapped.
3. **The actor input body (`queries`/`city`/`maxItems`) is still a best-effort guess** — apify.com is unreachable from the environment this was drafted in, so it's grounded in the actor's public description, not a confirmed live schema. Run a test execution; if it errors, open the actor's "API" or "Input" tab on Apify (you already have access — same place the placeIds error came from) for the exact field names and edit **Build Apify Request** to match, then share the error/output here if you want help fixing it.
4. **Map to Whizz Contacts** tries several likely field names per contact (title/name, phone/phoneNumber/phones[0], etc.) since the actor's exact output field names are equally unverified — adjust there too if real output looks different.

Whizz calls this at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-discover-2gis with body {query, location, brand, category, limit} and expects back {"contacts":[{name,phone,email,website,address,totalScore,url}]}.
